statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of four representative MPA paths.

page.notes: Public adult-comic catalog with listing, taxonomy, detail and 404 templates. Third-party live-video advertising is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop screenshot plus CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The default surface is dark and CSS inspection found color-scheme/prefers-color-scheme support; dark emulation remained fully usable.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the evaluate probe still found four running 1,000 ms mnThumbFadein animations and an actively playing muted autoplay video.
CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, while Lighthouse found many low-contrast counters and links.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/platform-probe.json, evidence/home-desktop.png, evidence/detail-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations; navigation between the listing, artist index and detail page is an abrupt full swap.
No scroll-linked animation surface or custom pointer/scroll animation script was present, so the page avoids main-thread scroll animation.
The representative pages expose ordinary links, scrolling and buttons but no carousel drag, swipe-to-remove, pull-to-reveal or other gesture-driven control to evaluate.
checkOutcomes.reason: No gesture-driven interaction exists on the audited templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The 13,751 px mobile home page retains static top/bottom chrome; CSS has no scroll-state/container query or progress affordance.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM semantic overlay and screenshot inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip, authored popover, contextual menu or anchored transient surface appears on the representative pages.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative path screenshots and DOM headings
checkOutcomes.evidence: Persistent navigation, breadcrumbs on detail, clear section headings and the 404 recovery copy preserve orientation across the MPA.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/home-desktop.png, evidence/home-mobile.png, evidence/detail-desktop.png, evidence/artists-desktop.png, evidence/notfound-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop, mobile, detail, artist and 404 screenshots show a live-video ad covering a large part of the content and even overlapping the age gate and bottom navigation.
DOM inspection found zero dialog, popover or details elements and one custom role=dialog div; the visible ad overlays site controls and relies on a tiny custom close target.
Screenshots show persistent header, bottom navigation and a large floating live-video panel occupying much of the first viewport, especially at 360 px.
At 360×800, both home and detail reported scrollWidth=clientWidth=360 and zero horizontal overflow with a viewport meta tag.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/platform-probe.json, evidence/home-mobile.png, evidence/detail-mobile.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile layout reflows without overflow, but CSS inspection found no @container rules for reusable cards, menus or the detail panel.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/platform-probe.json, evidence/lighthouse-home.json, evidence/home-mobile.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: The first focused button computed to a transparent outline with no box shadow. Lighthouse found undersized/obscured targets, and the probe found multiple 15–23 px-high links.
The H1, section labels, comic cards and detail metadata make the browsing/reading purpose and next comic-selection action clear.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/home-desktop.png, evidence/detail-desktop.png, evidence/home-mobile.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: The floating live-video ad covers comic cards, detail metadata and navigation on every representative path, forcing users to close advertising before reading.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP status, 404 screenshot and DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: A real 404 returned HTTP 404, used a descriptive heading, set noindex, offered navigation/search guidance and retained category links.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/lighthouse-home.json, evidence/lighthouse-detail.json, evidence/home-trace-summary.json, evidence/home-summary.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 5.1 s on home and 5.2 s on detail, while the lighter desktop trace measured 2.24 s; the throttled lab result indicates a common slow-device risk.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/lighthouse-home.json, evidence/home-mobile-layout.json, evidence/home-mobile.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage CLS 0.101 and identified five shifts; the mobile layout observer also recorded four late shifts totaling 0.043.
Trace found one 73 ms long task and only 23 ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 60–90 ms on the two templates.

HAR recorded 93 requests and 5.52 MB transferred, 5.22 MB third-party. It identified a VeryHigh-priority Google Fonts stylesheet plus parser-inserted ad scripts; Lighthouse flagged cache, font and render-blocking issues.
HAR recorded 14 scripts / 850 KB and 81 third-party requests; Lighthouse failed unused-javascript, with advertising and analytics loaded before user interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/lighthouse-home.json, evidence/lighthouse-detail.json, evidence/home-images.json, evidence/detail-images.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found missing alt text, four unnamed links on home, unnamed links on detail and untitled iframes; the image primitive counted three missing alt values on home and six on detail.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/lighthouse-home.json, evidence/lighthouse-detail.json, evidence/home-contrast.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found 30 contrast failures on home, including #15803d on #2e2f30 at 2.67:1 and #b91c1c at 2.07:1; detail also failed contrast.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/lighthouse-home.json, evidence/lighthouse-detail.json, evidence/platform-probe.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found invalid heading order and no main landmark on both templates; the focus probe found a transparent outline and no shadow on the first control.
Body and heading text remains readable and reflows without clipping at 360 px; the dark content surface provides stable line layout.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/home-mobile.png, evidence/home-mobile-layout.json, evidence/lighthouse-home.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page reflowed at 360 px without overflow, but Lighthouse reported target-size failures and the live ad partially obscured a 44 px bottom-nav control.
Lighthouse errors-in-console passed on both home and detail and recorded no uncaught console errors.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/home-images.json, evidence/detail-images.json, evidence/lighthouse-home.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Image probes found two images without dimensions on each template, 31/33 home images without srcset, and no modern-format content images. Lighthouse flagged image delivery.
Lighthouse reported three deprecation warnings and DevTools inspector issues from Cloudflare/ad integrations.
Home has a descriptive title and meta description; Lighthouse SEO scored 0.92 on home and detail.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM probe, robots.txt and discoverability fetch
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links use real hrefs, viewport meta is present, robots.txt only disallows /wp-admin/, and raw HTML contains the navigation/content.
Home returns 200, exposes a canonical URL and index/follow policy; robots permits public content and sitemap.xml is a populated sitemap index. The tested missing route correctly returns 404/noindex.
Home exposes a JSON-LD block and complete Open Graph title, description, URL and image matching the visible site.
The page uses HTTPS, but the headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. Six cookies were flagged insecure and all used SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/trackers.json, evidence/home-summary.json, evidence/cookies.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: Tracker evidence found 21 third-party origins and Google Analytics/Tag Manager; HAR recorded 81 third-party requests and 5.22 MB transferred before meaningful interaction.
No permission request, sign-in, account or authentication flow is part of the representative public browsing experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: No permission or authentication surface exists on the audited public paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Header inspection found no HSTS, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy or CSP frame-ancestors.
Discoverability fetch measured 86% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML, with title, H1 and description present and no empty JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/home-desktop.png, evidence/detail-desktop.png, evidence/artists-desktop.png, evidence/notfound-desktop.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: Across home, detail, artists and 404, the ad overlay covers fixed navigation and the age-confirmation dialog rather than repositioning or yielding to the viewport.
This is a public MPA content catalog, not an app-like workflow; no manifest or service worker exists, and installability is not needed for the core reading task.
checkOutcomes.reason: Offline installability is contextual and not proportionate for this content catalog.

checkOutcomes.method: HTTP status, screenshot and DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative missing route returns a real 404 with a clear explanation, retained navigation and suggested recovery paths rather than a blank shell.
The document declares lang=en, inherits normal LTR direction and CSS inspection found logical inline/block properties.
The core pages show content titles, tags and relative freshness labels but no user-entered dates, currency, calendar, duration or locale-sensitive transactional values.
checkOutcomes.reason: No locale-sensitive data model is present on the audited templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduled events, absolute timestamps, recurring intervals or cross-zone coordination appear in the audited experience.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/home-desktop.png, evidence/notfound-desktop.png, evidence/home-mobile.png
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage carousel inserts “Create your AI Slut (free)” among comic updates, while a separate live-video ad overlaps content and the Adults only decision dialog.
No authored form exists on home or the selected detail template, so there is no validation/error interaction to exercise.
checkOutcomes.reason: No form is present on the audited primary flow.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited primary flow has no text, address, payment or sign-in inputs requiring autocomplete assistance.
No checkout, subscription purchase, authentication or account-management flow is offered on the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No commercial or account flow exists in scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Home image evidence found 32 legacy-format images, zero modern formats and 31 missing srcset; detail showed 35 legacy images and 33 missing srcset.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct evidence from evidence/runtime-probe.json, evidence/home-summary.json, evidence/reduced-motion.json
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page auto-plays two videos; HAR transferred 5.52 MB, including multi-megabyte ad video XHRs, and 81 third-party requests on initial load.
Third parties account for 5.22 of 5.52 MB transferred, led by ad video origins at 2.14 MB and 1.53 MB, while the overlay actively obscures user content.
The public content is already server-rendered and richly linked, but the site exposes no transactional/productivity capability that needs a WebMCP tool.
checkOutcomes.reason: The emerging agent-tool surface is not applicable to this read-only catalog.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation, translation or other inference feature is offered where an on-device model would replace a server round trip.
Baseline heap was 25,726,222 bytes / 410,935 nodes; after ten repeated scroll/menu toggles it was 25,535,025 bytes / 410,136 nodes, showing no retained growth in this test.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary and runtime DOM-count probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The loaded page used a 25.7 MB V8 heap with 410,935 heap nodes for a media listing containing 1,572 DOM nodes and two ad iframes; the footprint remained bounded after interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap-summary constructor and total comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: The post-interaction heap summary was smaller than baseline and its top constructor table contained no Detached* population; no accumulation signal appeared across ten toggles.

principleOutcomes.reason: The emerging agent-tool surface is not applicable to this read-only catalog. No inference feature exists.

paths.description: Homepage listing and primary browse entry; represents the main listing template and initial ad/privacy/performance surface.
Representative comic detail/read entry; covers metadata, media presentation, related content and mobile detail layout.
Artist taxonomy/index; represents a distinct directory/filter template.
Real missing route; covers HTTP failure, recovery messaging, noindex and age-gate interaction.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not stop non-essential animation or autoplay media
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the evaluate probe still found four running 1,000 ms mnThumbFadein animations and an actively playing muted autoplay video.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule that removes thumbnail motion and prevent non-essential video autoplay when reduction is requested.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not explicitly supported
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules, while Lighthouse found many low-contrast counters and links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and avoid hard-coded colors that disappear in system contrast modes.

findings.summary: Route and state changes have no transition continuity
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations; navigation between the listing, artist index and detail page is an abrupt full swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Fixed navigation does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: The 13,751 px mobile home page retains static top/bottom chrome; CSS has no scroll-state/container query or progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware shrinking header or progress cue that preserves content space.

findings.summary: Autoplay advertising obscures the primary content
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, detail, artist and 404 screenshots show a live-video ad covering a large part of the content and even overlapping the age gate and bottom navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the on-load floating video. If advertising is required, reserve an inline slot and require user initiation for media.

findings.summary: Overlay UI is implemented as ad-hoc third-party chrome
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found zero dialog, popover or details elements and one custom role=dialog div; the visible ad overlays site controls and relies on a tiny custom close target.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog/popover semantics for first-party overlays, declarative dismissal, focus management, and keep third-party ads out of top-layer UI.

findings.summary: Advertising chrome competes with and covers content
findings.evidence: Screenshots show persistent header, bottom navigation and a large floating live-video panel occupying much of the first viewport, especially at 360 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent chrome and move proportional, labelled promotions into the document flow.

findings.summary: Components adapt only at page level, not by their container
findings.evidence: The mobile layout reflows without overflow, but CSS inspection found no @container rules for reusable cards, menus or the detail panel.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for cards and detail metadata where components appear at multiple widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and several targets are not reliably perceivable or large enough
findings.evidence: The first focused button computed to a transparent outline with no box shadow. Lighthouse found undersized/obscured targets, and the probe found multiple 15–23 px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a clearly visible :focus-visible style and at least 24×24 CSS px target space, preferably 44×44 for primary mobile controls.

findings.summary: The core browse-and-read journey is obstructed by a third-party overlay
findings.evidence: The floating live-video ad covers comic cards, detail metadata and navigation on every representative path, forcing users to close advertising before reading.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the listing-to-detail journey unobstructed and defer optional promotions until after user intent.

findings.summary: Lab LCP is outside the good range on primary templates
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 5.1 s on home and 5.2 s on detail, while the lighter desktop trace measured 2.24 s; the throttled lab result indicates a common slow-device risk.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP image/content, remove competing ad media, and defer non-critical third-party scripts.

findings.summary: Homepage layout shifts exceed the good stability target in Lighthouse
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage CLS 0.101 and identified five shifts; the mobile layout observer also recorded four late shifts totaling 0.043.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for every image/ad slot and do not inject floating media after layout.

findings.summary: Third-party media and render-blocking resources dominate delivery
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 93 requests and 5.52 MB transferred, 5.22 MB third-party. It identified a VeryHigh-priority Google Fonts stylesheet plus parser-inserted ad scripts; Lighthouse flagged cache, font and render-blocking issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or defer ad SDKs, self-host/subset fonts, set useful cache lifetimes and prioritise only the actual LCP resource.

findings.summary: Avoidable third-party and unused JavaScript is shipped on initial load
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 14 scripts / 850 KB and 81 third-party requests; Lighthouse failed unused-javascript, with advertising and analytics loaded before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate unused integrations and conditionally load advertising/analytics only after consent and when their surface enters view.

findings.summary: Images, links and frames lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found missing alt text, four unnamed links on home, unnamed links on detail and untitled iframes; the image primitive counted three missing alt values on home and six on detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful content images concise alt text, mark decorative/tracking pixels appropriately, name icon links, and title every iframe.

findings.summary: Repeated text fails WCAG contrast minimums
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 30 contrast failures on home, including #15803d on #2e2f30 at 2.67:1 and #b91c1c at 2.07:1; detail also failed contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose foreground tokens that meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text in every theme and state.

findings.summary: Heading hierarchy, landmarks and focus indication are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found invalid heading order and no main landmark on both templates; the focus probe found a transparent outline and no shadow on the first control.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one main landmark, repair sequential heading levels, and define strong :focus-visible styles without removing native focus.

findings.summary: Targets are undersized or obscured despite responsive reflow
findings.evidence: The page reflowed at 360 px without overflow, but Lighthouse reported target-size failures and the live ad partially obscured a 44 px bottom-nav control.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve reflow, enlarge crowded links, and prevent overlays from intersecting fixed mobile controls.

findings.summary: Image delivery and dimensions are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Image probes found two images without dimensions on each template, 31/33 home images without srcset, and no modern-format content images. Lighthouse flagged image delivery.
findings.suggestedFix: Supply intrinsic width/height, responsive srcset/sizes and AVIF/WebP alternatives while preserving correct aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and browser inspector issues are present
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported three deprecation warnings and DevTools inspector issues from Cloudflare/ad integrations.
findings.suggestedFix: Update or remove integrations that invoke deprecated storage/advertising APIs and clear DevTools Issues warnings.

findings.summary: Security headers are absent and analytics cookies are insecure
findings.evidence: The page uses HTTPS, but the headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. Six cookies were flagged insecure and all used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; mark all HTTPS cookies Secure and choose Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: The initial page load exposes users to a large tracking footprint
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 21 third-party origins and Google Analytics/Tag Manager; HAR recorded 81 third-party requests and 5.22 MB transferred before meaningful interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate non-essential analytics/ads behind informed consent, batch essential analytics and proxy/self-host where appropriate.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are not configured
findings.evidence: Header inspection found no HSTS, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy or CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add browser defense headers with least-privilege directives and test embedded third-party surfaces against the policy.

findings.summary: Third-party top-layer content collides with site controls and recovery UI
findings.evidence: Across home, detail, artists and 404, the ad overlay covers fixed navigation and the age-confirmation dialog rather than repositioning or yielding to the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Contain third-party content inline; ensure overlays stay within safe viewport bounds and never overlap modal or recovery controls.

findings.summary: Promotions are visually mixed into content and a live ad interrupts the age gate
findings.evidence: The homepage carousel inserts “Create your AI Slut (free)” among comic updates, while a separate live-video ad overlaps content and the Adults only decision dialog.
findings.suggestedFix: Label every promotion unambiguously, separate it visually from editorial cards, and never place advertising above age/consent decisions.

findings.summary: Content images lack responsive and modern-format delivery
findings.evidence: Home image evidence found 32 legacy-format images, zero modern formats and 31 missing srcset; detail showed 35 legacy images and 33 missing srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and responsive srcset/sizes for thumbnails and pages, with dimensions and lazy loading below fold.

findings.summary: Autoplay advertising performs substantial work before user intent
findings.evidence: The page auto-plays two videos; HAR transferred 5.52 MB, including multi-megabyte ad video XHRs, and 81 third-party requests on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not autoplay promotional media; load media and vendor code only after explicit activation or viewport entry.

findings.summary: Third-party media cost is disproportionate to the comic browsing task
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 5.22 of 5.52 MB transferred, led by ad video origins at 2.14 MB and 1.53 MB, while the overlay actively obscures user content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party budget, remove floating live video, and lazy-load any retained promotion after core content.

taskList.title: Remove on-load floating video and keep ads inline
Deploy security headers and secure cookie attributes
Cut third-party requests, trackers and autoplay media
Repair names, landmarks, headings, contrast and focus
